name: In Between
description: In Between is a banking gambling game where a player bets that a third card will rank strictly between two initial cards.

overview.description: In Between is a banking gambling game where a player bets that a third card will rank strictly between two initial cards.

history.origins: In Between appears in gambling and dealer's-choice traditions, with major name variants including Acey Deucey and Red Dog.
timeline: Early-mid 20th century: Documented in gambling references and home poker rotations.
Late 20th century: Casino adaptation popularized as Red Dog side-game formats.
history.cultural: Known as a quick betting game with simple rules and high variance.
history.evolution: Home pot-banker versions and casino fixed-odds versions diverged in payout structures and bet windows.

setup.dealing: Dealer gives two initial face-up cards for a wager decision, then a third resolving card.
setup.equipment: Deck, chips, and a banker/dealer position.

rules.objective: Win bets by correctly calling that the third card falls strictly between the first two card ranks.
rules.gameplay: In the dealer-as-banker form, each non-dealer player is resolved in turn. Dealer reveals first card, then second card for that player. Player may fold or bet up to the pot limit. Dealer reveals third card and settles: strictly between = win amount equal to bet, outside range = lose bet, equal to an endpoint = lose double ('hitting the post').
keyRules: Third card strictly between first two ranks is a win.
Third card outside interval is a loss.
Third card equal to an endpoint commonly loses double (hitting the post) in many rulesets.
Consecutive first two cards usually produce a push in several versions.
Pair starts are handled by special house payout rules.

strategy.basic: Bet larger only when the rank spread between first two cards is wide.
strategy.intermediate: Use spread-based expected value to choose raise, call, or fold actions.
strategy.advanced: Exploit format-specific payout tables (home banker vs casino Red Dog) and avoid overbetting narrow spreads.
tips: House edge shifts significantly with endpoint and pair rules.

variations.name: Pot Banker
variations.description: Dealer acts as banker and players wager against shared pot.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant uses same engine as base; no overrides needed.

variations.name: Casino Red Dog
variations.description: Single house deal with fixed spread-based payouts.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Payout table differs; add overrides when spread payouts are specified.

scoring.description: Wager-settlement game with table-defined payout rules.
scoring.winCondition: Finish agreed rounds with positive net chips versus the banker or empty the pot as bettor.

synthesis.shortDescription: Bet whether the third card lands between two exposed ranks.
